tips: Ambessa has extreme mobility. Do NOT waste your W (Cage) until she has used her dash.
She excels in short trades. Last hit with E and only trade when you have 4 ghouls.
Rush Plated Steelcaps early to survive her burst combos.
Level 1-2 you lose. Do not fight. Farm with E.
Save your W (Cage) for when he tries to run you down with Ghost.
If you trap him in the cage, he is a sitting duck for your Maiden and Ghouls.
Jax is your biggest counter. He can dodge your Ghoul attacks with his E (Counter Strike).
Do NOT spawn Maiden if his E is up. Wait for him to waste it.
Play for the late-game split push. You cannot 1v1 him early.
Garen cannot escape your W (Cage) easily. Trap him and let the Ghouls shred him.
Build Serylda's Grudge early to stop him from running away.
Respect his R (Execute) when you are below 30% HP.
